function.name: impl_from_IWICBitmapFrameEncode
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a BmpFrameEncode structure that contains the given IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface

function.return_type: BmpFrameEncode *; Pointer to a BmpFrameEncode structure that contains the given IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query the interfaces supported by the BmpFrameEncode object. It checks if the requested interface (identified by the iid parameter) is supported by the object. If it is, a pointer to that interface is returned through the ppv parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface of the BmpFrameEncode object.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being queried.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppv will contain NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the ppv parameter is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If the object does not support the requested interface, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a BMP frame encode object and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the BMP frame encode interface object whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the BMP frame encode object.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_Release
function.description: This function releases the bitmap frame encode interface and frees up the memory used by it if the reference count is zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the bitmap frame encode interface that needs to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the reference count after decrementing. If the reference count is zero, the memory used by the interface is freed.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes a BMP frame for encoding. If the frame is already initialized, it returns an error. It also warns if encoder options are provided, as these are ignored.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to a bitmap frame that is to be encoded.

parameters.name: pIEncoderOptions
parameters.description: This is a set of encoder options. However, this function ignores any provided encoder options.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the frame is already initialized.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_SetSize
function.description: This function sets the width and height of a bitmap frame encode object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface

parameters.name: uiWidth
parameters.description: The width to set for the bitmap frame

parameters.name: uiHeight
parameters.description: The height to set for the bitmap frame

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, otherwise returns an error code

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_SetResolution
function.description: This function sets the resolution for a BMP frame encode object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: A pointer to the BMP frame encode interface.

parameters.name: dpiX
parameters.description: The horizontal resolution to set.

parameters.name: dpiY
parameters.description: The vertical resolution to set.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error code if not.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_SetPixelFormat
function.description: This function sets the pixel format for a bitmap frame encode object. It checks if the object is initialized and if it has bits. If not, it returns an error. It then checks the provided pixel format and modifies it if necessary. It then iterates over a list of formats until it finds a match for the provided pixel format. If no match is found, it defaults to the first format. It then sets the object's format to the matched format and copies the format's GUID to the provided pixel format.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: A pointer to the bitmap frame encode object.

parameters.name: pPixelFormat
parameters.description: A pointer to the pixel format GUID. This will be modified by the function.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_SetColorContexts
function.description: This function is a stub and not yet implemented. It is intended to set color contexts for a bitmap frame encode interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface

parameters.name: cCount
parameters.description: Count of color contexts

parameters.name: ppIColorContext
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IWICColorContext interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_SetPalette
function.description: This function sets the palette for a BMP frame encode object. It checks if the palette is valid and if the object is initialized. It then gets the colors from the palette and sets them to the BMP frame encode object's palette. It also sets the alpha value for each color in the palette to 0xff000000 as BMP palette has no alpha.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the BMP frame encode object.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: This is the palette to be set to the BMP frame encode object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the palette is NULL, and WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the BMP frame encode object is not initialized.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_SetThumbnail
function.description: This function is a stub and currently does not support the operation of setting a thumbnail for a bitmap frame encode.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface to a bitmap frame encode.

parameters.name: pIThumbnail
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the thumbnail bitmap source.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Currently, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is not supported.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_AllocateBits
function.description: This function allocates memory for the bits in a BMP frame. It checks if the frame is initialized, has width, height and format. If not, it returns an error. If these conditions are met, it calculates the stride and allocates memory for the bits. If the memory allocation fails, it returns an out of memory error.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the BmpFrameEncode structure which contains the information about the BMP frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the frame is not properly initialized or has no width, height or format. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation for the bits fails. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_WritePixels
function.description: This function writes pixel data to a bitmap frame. It checks if the frame is initialized and has valid dimensions and format. It then allocates memory for the pixel data, validates the input parameters, and copies the pixel data to the frame. It also updates the number of lines written to the frame.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap frame to write pixels to.

parameters.name: lineCount
parameters.description: Number of lines of pixels to write.

parameters.name: cbStride
parameters.description: Number of bytes in a row of the source pixel data.

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: Size of the buffer that contains the source pixel data.

parameters.name: pbPixels
parameters.description: Pointer to the source pixel data.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be S_OK if the operation is successful, WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the frame is not initialized or has invalid dimensions or format, E_INVALIDARG if the input parameters are invalid, or other error codes if the operation fails for other reasons.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_WriteSource
function.description: This function is used to write the source of a bitmap frame encode. It checks if the bitmap frame encode is initialized, configures the write source and writes the source.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap frame encode interface

parameters.name: pIBitmapSource
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap source

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle structure that specifies the portion of the bitmap to write

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds or an error code if it fails.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_Commit
function.description: This function commits a bitmap frame encode, writing the bitmap file header, bitmap info header, palette (if any), and bitmap data to the stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface pointer to the bitmap frame that needs to be encoded.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the bitmap frame is in an incorrect state, E_FAIL if the written bytes do not match the expected size, or other error codes if the stream operations fail.

function.name: BmpFrameEncode_GetMetadataQueryWriter
function.description: This function retrieves the metadata query writer from the BMP frame encoder interface. If the encoder is not initialized, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the BMP frame encoder interface.

parameters.name: query_writer
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the metadata query writer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the encoder is not initialized and WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION otherwise.

function.name: impl_from_IWICBitmapEncoder
function.description: This function retrieves the BmpEncoder instance from the IWICBitmapEncoder interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapEncoder interface.

function.return_type: BmpEncoder *: A pointer to the BmpEncoder instance.

function.name: BmpEncoder_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the specified interface ID (IID). If it does, it returns a pointer to that interface; otherwise, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICBitmapEncoder interface.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being queried for.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppv is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the interface is not supported, it returns E_NOINTERFACE. If ppv is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG.

function.name: BmpEncoder_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a BMP encoder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapEncoder interface of the BMP encoder object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: BmpEncoder_Release
function.description: This function releases the resources of a BMP encoder. It decreases the reference count and if it reaches zero, it releases the stream and frame if they exist, and frees the memory allocated for the encoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the bitmap encoder to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement operation.

function.name: BmpEncoder_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes the BMP encoder with the provided interface, stream, and cache option.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface for the bitmap encoder.

parameters.name: pIStream
parameters.description: This is the stream that the encoder will use.

parameters.name: cacheOption
parameters.description: This is the cache option for the encoder.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: BmpEncoder_GetContainerFormat
function.description: This function gets the container format of a Bitmap Encoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the Bitmap Encoder interface.

parameters.name: pguidContainerFormat
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a GUID object where the container format will be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if the pguidContainerFormat is NULL.

function.name: BmpEncoder_GetEncoderInfo
function.description: This function retrieves the encoder information for a bitmap encoder interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the bitmap encoder interface.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the bitmap encoder information.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if the info parameter is NULL, or an error code if the operation fails.

function.name: BmpEncoder_SetColorContexts
function.description: This function is a stub and currently not implemented. It is supposed to set color contexts for a BMP encoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapEncoder interface

parameters.name: cCount
parameters.description: Unsigned integer representing the count of color contexts

parameters.name: ppIColorContext
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IWICColorContext interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented.

function.name: BmpEncoder_SetPalette
function.description: This function sets the palette for a Bitmap Encoder. It returns an error if the stream is not initialized or if the operation is unsupported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface to the Bitmap Encoder.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: This is the palette to be set for the Bitmap Encoder.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION if the operation is unsupported, or WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the stream is not initialized.

function.name: BmpEncoder_SetThumbnail
function.description: This function sets the thumbnail for a Bitmap Encoder. However, it currently returns an error indicating that this operation is unsupported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the Bitmap Encoder.

parameters.name: pIThumbnail
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the thumbnail source.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a data type used in Windows programming to represent error conditions, and warning conditions. In this case, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is not supported.

function.name: BmpEncoder_SetPreview
function.description: This function is used to set the preview for a Bitmap Encoder. However, the operation is unsupported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the Bitmap Encoder.

parameters.name: pIPreview
parameters.description: This is the preview image source.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating the operation is unsupported.

function.name: BmpEncoder_CreateNewFrame
function.description: This function creates a new frame for a Bitmap Encoder. It initializes the frame and sets up the encoder options.

parameters.name: IWICBitmapEncoder *iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the Bitmap Encoder interface.

parameters.name: IWICBitmapFrameEncode **ppIFrameEncode
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the Bitmap Frame Encode interface. The function will create a new frame and store the pointer here.

parameters.name: IPropertyBag2 **ppIEncoderOptions
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the Property Bag interface. The function will create a new property bag and store the pointer here.

function.return_type: HRESULT. This is the return type of the function. It represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: BmpEncoder_Commit
function.description: This function commits the BMP encoder if the frame exists and is committed.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the bitmap encoder.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE.

function.name: BmpEncoder_GetMetadataQueryWriter
function.description: This function is a stub and not yet implemented. It is intended to get the metadata query writer from a bitmap encoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a bitmap encoder

parameters.name: ppIMetadataQueryWriter
parameters.description: Double pointer to a metadata query writer interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: BmpEncoder_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a BMP encoder, queries an interface and then releases the encoder.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: The reference to the interface identifier to be queried.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the location of the queried interface pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If successful, it returns S_OK. If the encoder instance cannot be created, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY.
